parameters.content:
## Receive

The gateway posts the end reason when the call drops or the transfer completes.

## Load state

Prompts for the spoken lines; the session row decides the outcome.

## Outcome

CaseOutcome in order: booked, moved or cancelled (Resolved, DealerBook sent the confirmation); callback logged (Delegated to XCCC); self-service (Resolved); ended in HANDOFF or a handoff end reason (Delegated); otherwise Closed.

## Close

Chat memory purged, session finalised, end logged. Nothing of the call is retained beyond ar_events.

## AR-03 Session end

Every journey ends with the case closed in CASE. The outcome comes from the session row; DealerBook confirms bookings, cancellations and moves to the customer, so nothing is sent from here. Chat memory for the session is deleted: no transcript survives the call.

meta.description: POST /webhook/ar/v1/session/end. Closes or delegates the CASE case with the journey's outcome (booked, moved, cancelled, callback, self-service, handed off, closed), purges the chat memory rows for the session, finalises the session row and logs. DealerBook sends the customer confirmation. Idempotent.
